what: MINT-ID-POST-FREEZE: scripts/ops/pipeline.py mint_id() reads read_log(store), which after the WORK-STORE S4 freeze reads work_store.db only where that file exists (the live VM) and otherwise the FROZEN export files. From a cloud session it therefore cannot see items written since the freeze and re-mints a taken id. MEASURED 2026-11-12 16:28Z: mint_id('session_01AFoLuMw1bWyUmi4HkqYBX8') returned PI-20261112-4HKQYBX8-0001 again, an id written to the store at 15:04:41Z, and append(intent='new') refused it (the guard works; nothing was displaced). Effect: every cloud session's second new pipeline item of a day fails until the id is hand-picked. Fix: when frozen and there is no local DB, mint against the live store, e.g. GET /api/bot/work/items?kind=observation filtered to the session tag, the same RemoteWorkStore paging src/console_connector/data.py uses.
